biography: ## About John Cordisco has built his multidisciplinary career on command and leadership. His career spans business services, IT, construction, real estate development, security, power generation, and the military. John’s strengths and successes have been driven by hands on leadership in driving goal-oriented teams to execute high value initiatives with proven results. John has consulted and managed companies on projects in five continents, for both owners and contractors providing project services such as plant operations, regulatory compliance, risk mitigation, construction management, worker safety, security consulting, project management, project engineering, contract negotiation, sales, and dispute resolution. His consistency in producing successful results often puts him at the forefront of project leadership and operational management. He is a proud US Marine Corps War Veteran and hold a Bachelor of Science in Management. John has extensive experience in managing operations, engineering and construction teams on projects for the nuclear power generation industry, as well as government institutions, and Fortune 500 clients. His expertise includes analysis of site conditions, utility and infrastructure planning, schedule adherence, inefficiencies, project performance, cost estimation, cost management, productivity, procurement impacts, facility and business interruptions, manpower deployment and contract adherence. He has experience throughout the project lifecycle including stakeholder engagement, engineering and development due diligence, team development, financial forecasting, project funding, contractor and vendor management, construction supervisor and project closeout. John has extensive experience drafting and negotiating numerous types of contracts and financial instruments. His engagement experience has included assessments of pre-design work, project delivery methods, constructability reviews, estimation of project-capital cost submittals, bidding activities, project start-up and operations, value engineering, contract administration, quality assurance, and errors and omissions reporting.
